name: Wekan
tagline: Open source Trello-like Kanban. Meteor + MongoDB, self-hostable.
shortDescription: Wekan is an open source Trello-like Kanban board. Meteor + MongoDB, drag-and-drop cards, swimlanes, checklists, attachments, and a real-time UI.
longDescription:
## What it is

Wekan is an open source Kanban board. Meteor + MongoDB, drag-and-drop cards, swimlanes, checklists, attachments, labels, due dates, real-time updates, and a self-hostable architecture.

## Why we recommend it

If you want a Trello clone you can fully own, Wekan is the answer. The feature set is comprehensive, the UI is familiar, and the codebase has been around since 2014.

## When to use it

- Self-hosted Trello alternative
- Teams that want Kanban without the SaaS fee
- Personal task management
- Multi-board setups with shared swimlanes
installInstructions:
**Docker:**
```
docker run -d --name wekan -p 8080:8080 wekan/wekan
```

**Sandstorm:** One-click install at sandstorm.io.
pricingDetails: Free. MIT licensed. Self-host on a small VPS.
